crossRefs.note: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

translations.web: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
translations.bsb: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
translations.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her ➔ not leave him.
translations.asv: And the woman that hath an unbelieving husband, and he is content to dwell with her, let her not leave her husband.
